items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 FAILed because all 9 MIGRATION-MAPPING.md rows were still Status=copied; the agent had to bulk-flip them to done and re-run.
items.evidence: session-log turn 35 (validator '[FAIL] ... 9 row(s) still Status=copied') -> turn 36 bulk replace '| copied |' -> '| done |' -> turn 37 validator PASS.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 1 line 90 ('Flip Status from copied -> done (or deferred) as each row is finished') and line 86 ('migrate-as-is ... flip Status to done once the file appears in your final build'); plus Step 4 validator fix note line 167 ('Status = copied rows -> those files were never finished. Either complete ... and flip to done, or defer').
items.why_no_skill_change: The skill already tells the agent, prominently and in two places, to flip Status to done as each file is finished and that the validator checks for it. A capable model on re-run flips the rows as it goes (or immediately when the validator flags them, as this one did in a single retry). Adding more prose would just restate existing guidance.
